categorisation: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory order made under the Immigrants and Emigrants Act (Chapter 351) by the Minister, declaring an approved port of entry and exit. It establishes a regulatory framework for immigration procedures rather than focusing on government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories. The content primarily involves statutory authority and regulatory compliance requirements.
